nudge: 'As áreas de proteção' are ground where hunting is banned, one kind of terreno não cinegético. Areas under maritime jurisdiction are hunting ground (questions 13 and 18), and 'zonas de caça nacionais' are hunting zones, managed hunting ground like the municipal one of question 17.

nudge: The definition covers 'todos os terrenos onde é proibido o exercício da caça', whatever kind they are. The two 'apenas' options each cut it down to two named kinds of area, narrower than the definition.

A 'zona de caça municipal' is a hunting zone, and hunting zones are managed hunting grounds. Training grounds and game refuges are not hunting grounds: question 13 offers them together as the wrong answer.

The definition of terrenos cinegéticos expressly includes 'as áreas de jurisdição marítima' (question 13). Protection areas are non-hunting ground (question 15), and training grounds are not hunting grounds (question 17).

Matilheiros work a pack of hounds, the matilha, so they flush game 'com a ajuda de cães', and that game is 'caça maior', as in a montaria. The distractors swap one half each: small game with dogs, or big game without them.

language.note: The se makes the verb passive, 'is considered (to be)'; the subject named after it is what the options define.

nudge: Época venatória is the hunting year, fixed by date: 'entre o dia 1 de junho de cada ano e o dia 31 de maio do ano seguinte'. The time when a species may be hunted is a different term, the período venatório of question 26.

language.en: there is one who may not
language.note: há um que = there is one that: the stem asks for the single exception, and não pode = may not.

nudge: Negaceiros set and work the negaças, the decoys, and do not pursue game with dogs. Matilheiros pursue big game with a pack (question 19), and batedores may use dogs to drive the game in a batida.

Época venatória is the hunting year, 'o período anual que decorre entre o dia 1 de junho de cada ano e o dia 31 de maio do ano seguinte'. The span in which each species may be hunted is a different term, the período venatório of questions 26 and 43.

language.pt: desde que o barco esteja em movimento
language.en: provided that the boat is in motion
language.note: desde que = provided that, with the present subjunctive esteja: a condition attached to the permission.
só = only: the permission is limited to moving between hide positions and to the hides themselves.

language.pt: se atire com o motor em movimento
language.en: one shoots with the engine running
language.note: se atire = one shoots: impersonal se, not 'throws itself', in the subjunctive after desde que.

nudge: The boat is allowed 'só nas deslocações entre locais de espera e nas esperas', moving between hide positions and in the hides themselves. The two 'desde que' options make a moving boat or a running engine the condition, which the keyed rule does not.

language.en: may be hunted from a boat
language.note: se pode caçar = may be hunted: passive se, not 'can hunt itself'.

nudge: Ducks, 'galinha-d’água e galeirão' may be hunted from a boat. The lists differ in one bird: woodcock and snipe are not hunted from a boat, as question 50 confirms.

October is inside the partridge season (question 462) and walked-up is a partridge method (question 455), so neither the month nor the method is the offence. Ten dogs walked-up is the rabbit allowance (questions 29 and 30), and for partridge it is 'um número de cães superior ao permitido'.

The período venatório belongs to a species: 'o intervalo de tempo em que pode ser caçada'. 1 June to 31 May is the época venatória, the hunting year (question 20), and a licence's validity is a separate matter.

language.note: não é proibida = is not prohibited: the stem asks which species may still be hunted on snow.

nudge: On snow-covered ground hunting is banned for rabbit and fox, but not for 'Javali', the wild boar. Question 385 agrees: hunting wild boar in snow is not a crime.

Chamarizes, lure calls, are allowed for 'Patos', and question 46 adds fox, red deer and roe deer but not thrushes or pigeons. Do not confuse them with negaças, the decoys allowed for pigeons (question 35).

language.note: The question word comes last: que espécies? = which species?, the object of pode caçar.

nudge: Ten dogs walked-up is the rabbit allowance: question 30 caps rabbit hunting by any method other than batida at '10 cães'. Hare and fox are not covered by it, and question 25 shows ten is over the limit for partridge.

language.pt: por processo diferente do de batida
language.en: by a method other than the driven method
language.note: diferente do de batida = other than that of batida: every rabbit method except the driven one.

nudge: For rabbit by any method but batida, the cap is '10 cães' per hunter or group. Fifty is the figure for fox coursing (question 31).
Fox coursing allows up to '50' dogs. It is not unlimited: the no-limit rule belongs to montarias (question 50).

Taking 'crias ou ovos de qualquer espécie, cinegética ou não' is banned. Sunrise to sunset is when hunting is normally allowed (question 33), and Thursday is a hunting day on unmanaged ground (question 57).

language.pt: só é permitido entre o nascer e o pôr-do-sol
language.en: is only permitted between sunrise and sunset
language.note: só = only: as a rule, hunting is limited to the daylight hours.

nudge: The exception is big game hunted 'pelo processo de espera', which may be authorised 'em período de lua cheia', after dark. A finish at 17 horas would still sit inside the daylight hours, so it is no exception.

Aproximação, stalking, is a big-game method: the hunter moves in on 'determinado exemplar de caça maior' (question 39). Question 419 limits it 'Só às espécies de caça maior', and question 421 bans it for small game.
Negaças, decoys, are allowed for 'pombos', 'patos', 'pega-rabuda' and 'gralha-preta'. Question 50 marks decoys for snipe and plovers as wrong, and coot and moorhen are not on the list.

language.note: não podem = may not: every option states a ban, so the question is which ban applies to assistants.

nudge: Assistants help the hunter without hunting themselves, so they 'Não podem fazer parte da linha de caçadores'. The other two options ban carrying ammunition or cased guns, which the keyed rule does not.

language.note: por cada = for each: the count applies to each hare coursed.

nudge: Hare coursing allows 'Dois cães de busca e dois cães galgos por cada lebre', two search dogs and two greyhounds. Question 38 repeats the same two-and-two limit; the distractors shift the split.

Hare coursing allows 'Dois cães galgos e dois cães de busca a cada lebre', as in question 37. Ten dogs for rabbit is the limit for methods other than batida (question 30), so 'pelo processo de batida' makes that option wrong.

language.note: designa-se = is called, passive se; the name comes in the options.

nudge: Aproximação is stalking: the hunter 'se desloca' towards 'determinado exemplar de caça maior', one chosen animal. In salto the hunter walks up whatever the ground flushes, and in a batida the hunter waits while beaters drive the game (question 40).

language.note: denomina-se = is called, passive se; the name comes in the options.

nudge: In a batida the hunter waits at a post for game 'levantadas por batedores', the beaters. In a montaria it is packs of hounds worked by matilheiros that drive the game, and à espera the hunter waits with no one driving it.

Battery-powered devices to attract game 'Não podem ser utilizados na caça', with no exception for ducks or for predator control. Lure calls worked by the hunter are a different thing and are allowed for ducks (question 28).

As in question 41, battery-powered devices 'Não podem ser utilizados na caça', ducks and thrushes included. Ducks may be hunted with lure calls the hunter works (question 28), not with battery devices.

language.note: The se makes the verb passive, 'is considered (to be)'; the subject named after it is what the options define.
só se pode caçar = one may only hunt: impersonal se, and só limits it to the species listed.

nudge: The período venatório is 'o intervalo de tempo em que cada uma das espécies pode ser caçada': each species has its own. The 'só' options tie it to a fixed group of species, which the definition does not.

language.en: it is not permitted to use
language.note: não é permitido = is not permitted: the stem asks for the one thing excluded.

nudge: Corricão is coursing: dogs run the game down, the hunter on foot or on 'cavalo', with or without a 'pau', and never with 'Armas de fogo'. Question 52 asks it the other way round, which method rules out the firearm, and the answer there is corricão.
The daily bag is 'O definido no calendário venatório anual': the yearly hunting calendar sets bag limits. So there is a limit, and it is not a fixed 50 rabbits.

Lure calls, chamarizes, are allowed 'na caça aos patos, à raposa, ao veado e ao corço'. Thrushes are the odd one out in the shorter list (question 28 leaves them out too), and the ban is not absolute.

language.note: só = only: it limits the horse to that one use and nothing else.

language.en: it is not permitted to use
language.note: não é permitido = is not permitted: the stem asks for the one thing excluded.

nudge: As in question 44, corricão is coursing with dogs, the hunter on foot or on 'cavalo', and never with 'Armas de fogo'. Dogs and horse are its tools, so they cannot be what it forbids.

language.pt: só é permitido em que processos de caça
language.en: is only permitted in which hunting methods
language.note: só limits the stick to the methods asked for; em que processos? = in which methods?, the question word comes late.

nudge: The pau is allowed only in coursing and walked-up hunting: 'Corricão e de salto'. Every option has salto, so the partner decides, and batida and montaria are the wrong ones.
Montarias have no cap on dogs: 'não há limite de número de cães'. Boats are not for snipe or woodcock (question 24), and decoys are not for snipe or plovers (question 35).

language.note: denomina-se = is called, passive se; the name comes in the options.

nudge: Cetraria is falconry: game is taken by an 'ave de presa adestrada', a trained bird of prey. A batida drives game to hunters at posts, and corricão is coursing with dogs.

language.pt: não pode utilizar arma de fogo
language.note: não pode = may not: the stem asks which method rules the firearm out.
pretender = to intend, a false friend: not 'pretend'.

nudge: Corricão is coursing with dogs, on foot or on horseback, and never with a firearm (questions 44 and 48). In salto the hunter shoots what the ground flushes, and a montaria drives big game to hunters at posts.

Only species 'que constem do calendário venatório publicado anualmente' may be hunted, and question 387 is the same question. Being classed as game is not enough, and damage to farming does not by itself make a species huntable.
On unmanaged ground each hunter may take 'Um auxiliar', one assistant. The number decides; three and five are distractors.

As in question 19, matilheiros work a pack of hounds, so they flush game 'com a ajuda de cães', and that game is 'caça maior', as in a montaria. The distractors swap one half each: small game with dogs, or big game without them.

On unmanaged ground fox coursing 'pode ser exercida às quartas-feiras e sábados'. Stalking wild boar is allowed only on managed ground (question 447), and a fox batida there needs the January and February window set in an ICNF public notice (question 448).

With a firearm on unmanaged ground the days are 'quintas-feiras, domingos e feriados nacionais obrigatórios'. Saturdays and municipal holidays are not among them; Saturday is a coursing day (question 56).

language.pt: Só é permitida em três dias
language.en: Is only permitted on three days
language.note: só = only: it limits big-game hunting to three days a week.

language.pt: apenas nas zonas de caça turísticas
language.note: apenas = only: any day of the week, but only in that kind of zone.

nudge: On managed ground big game is hunted 'nos dias previstos nos respetivos planos de ordenamento cinegético ou exploração', the days each zone's own plan sets. The 'Só' and 'apenas' options impose a fixed limit the keyed rule does not.
